title: 一键寄存 Push2Deposit
description: Allows you to transfer items into chests quickly by left-clicking. Inspired by Hypixel Bedwars
body:
This mod allows you to quickly deposit items by left-clicking on chests/barrels. This idea originates from Hypixel Bedwars.
本mod允许您通过左键单击箱子/木桶将物品快速寄存,创意来自于Hypixel Bedwars。

Report any issues on [Github](https://github.com/laialaodi/Push2Deposit/issues)
有问题欢迎在[Github](https://github.com/laialaodi/Push2Deposit/issues)上反馈
